assertions.name: one_admission_per_observed_inbound_exchange
assertions.meaning: Each inbound exchange, identified independently by the client and the oracle, has exactly one internal admission. A fresh ExchangeId does not reset the count.

assertions.name: same_required_obligations_at_both_checkpoints
assertions.meaning: Both checkpoints hold the same obligations: DeliveryId, target SessionId, cause, effective QoS and payload reference. A count of two is not enough.

assertions.name: same_recipe_for_op_A
assertions.meaning: The canonical recipe stored for the operation bound as op_A is byte-identical at every observation.

assertions.name: no_positive_ack_before_confirmed_commit
assertions.meaning: No positive acknowledgement is eligible before the core received a confirmation or recovered a sufficient durable fact, even if the store had committed.

assertions.name: no_pubrec_observed_before_crash
assertions.meaning: The peer decoder observed no PUBREC of the exchange before the crash.

assertions.name: broker_inputs_have_provenance
assertions.meaning: Every input the core consumed is a recovery page the store adapter read, a result or a deadline answering an effect still in flight, or a packet from bytes the transport received; and no input was refused for lack of correlation.

assertions.name: fenced_operation_never_executed
assertions.meaning: Once an operation is fenced or refused with certainty, the store never commits it: no commit follows its fence in the trace, and no snapshot holds both.

assertions.name: certain_rejection_has_a_closure
assertions.meaning: Every certain refusal the store reports has what makes it certain: a fence written before it, or a receipt of rejection or a fence that a snapshot holds. An absence that was only read is not one.

assertions.name: all_required_faults_hit
assertions.meaning: Every declared injection was reached exactly as many times as expected; otherwise the run is inconclusive.

assertions.name: trace_complete
assertions.meaning: The trace has its header, a gapless record sequence per origin and a footer declaring completeness.

assertions.name: refusal_carries_the_reason_of_its_rejection
assertions.meaning: A PUBREC that refuses an admission carries the reason the transition catalogue gives for the reason of the certain rejection the core received for it, in the same incarnation, before the frame. It judges the decision of the core on what the core received; that what the core received is what the store produced is the matter of broker_inputs_have_provenance (K1).

assertions.name: one_grant_per_opened_epoch
assertions.meaning: At most one grant is handed over per opened epoch, and each follows, among its causes in the same incarnation of the core, a committed reply for that epoch to an attempt whose epoch the store opened.

assertions.name: terminal_knowledge_never_regresses
assertions.meaning: An unknown result consumed after a terminal result of the same operation changes nothing: nothing the core does follows from it, no second acknowledgement, no new resolution of the operation.

assertions.name: scenario_reaches_its_end
assertions.meaning: The run reached the last step of its scenario. A DriveUntil step asserts that the awaited event comes with no stimulus beyond what the scenario has already injected; a run the bench stopped because no action was eligible and the wait was unmet refutes that assertion for this run, and fails. It does not establish that the product is stuck for ever. A run stopped by its budget of steps concludes nothing.
